name: Camp Lawrence
description_short: Overnight YMCA camp for boys ages 8-16 on Bear Island in Lake Winnipesaukee, NH, with two-week sessions (one-week sessions only for first-time junior campers). Boys choose their own schedule from sports, waterfront, arts and outdoor-skills activities.
refund_policy_summary: Deposit ($300 per two-week session, $200 per one-week session) is due at registration and is non-refundable. Full balance is due April 1, 2027, with a $150 late fee after that. After April 1, tuition is non-refundable and non-transferable, except for a documented camper illness or death of an immediate family member. Cancellations must be emailed to campinfo@mvymca.org.
special_needs_notes: The camp can handle most dietary preferences (vegetarian, gluten-free, etc.), and staff are told about known food allergies. There are two full-time nurses. Parents of first-time campers fill out a 'Let's Get Acquainted' form that the director reviews.
swim_waterfront_notes: Lakefront camp on Lake Winnipesaukee with two natural beaches. Every camper takes swim lessons, and there is open swim. Many staff are certified lifeguards. Waterfront activities include canoeing, kayaking, sailing, paddle boarding, snorkeling, waterskiing and fishing.
